Studio Manifesto

WE DON’T JUST DESIGN ROOMS.
WE SHAPE THE WAY A SPACE MAKES YOU FEEL.

Every architectural space possesses an inherent energy. Our role is not to impose heavy trends, but to listen to the light, proportion, and texture — sculpting environments that feel quiet, grounded, and enduring.

VIEW ALL PROJECTS
01•Residential

The Pali Residence

Pali Hill, Mumbai · 2024

A 3,200 sq ft family residence in the heart of Pali Hill, reimagined as a calm, layered interior that balances warmth with restraint. Every material was chosen for its tactile quality and its ability to age gracefully.

Explore Case Study
02•Residential

Altitude Penthouse

Worli, Mumbai · 2024

A sky-level penthouse with panoramic sea views required a design language that would not compete with the horizon. We chose restraint — deep tones, natural stone, and a palette that recedes to let the city speak.

Explore Case Study
03•Commercial

Chapter One Café

Bandra West, Mumbai · 2023

A neighbourhood café designed around the rituals of reading and slow mornings. The brief was for a space that felt like it had always been there — worn-in, comfortable, full of character.

Explore Case Study
Our Approach

DESIGNED FOR
THE WAY YOU LIVE.

01 — Context

Every space responds to its architectural shell, surrounding light, and geographical setting. We design from the outside in.

02 — Materiality

Authentic stones, solid timbers, and hand-applied plasters that gain character over time rather than wearing out.

03 — Function

Uncompromised practical layouts engineered around daily rituals, circulation paths, and intuitive storage.

04 — Emotion

Spaces designed to evoke feeling — creating atmosphere through light control, acoustic softness, and tactile warmth.

Methodology

From Concept
to Keys.

01

Discover

Brief & Site Audit

Understanding your lifestyle, spatial requirements, site conditions, and budget parameters.

02

Define

Spatial Layouts & 3D

Testing floorplate options and establishing 3D visualisations with material direction.

03

Design

Technical Drawings

Detailed GFC sets, joinery specifications, electrical plans, and fixed BOQs.

04

Develop

Execution & Crafts

On-site construction supervision, artisan metal/stone work, and procurement tracking.

05

Deliver

Styling & Handover

White-glove deep cleaning, art curation, final snagging, and key presentation.
